note: Origins whose recorded exports are largely re-exports or transshipment. A flagged origin is a possible transit hub, not a disqualified supplier: the brief annotates it and prefers a non-hub origin for its next action. Re-export data (resilience:recovery:reexport-share:v1) covers only AE and PA, so this list is a reviewed judgement, not a measurement.

hubs.label: United Arab Emirates
hubs.rationale: Jebel Ali and Dubai free zones re-export a large share of recorded exports; Comtrade publishes an RX flow for the UAE.

hubs.label: Singapore
hubs.rationale: Entrepot economy; re-exports are roughly half of merchandise exports, and Comtrade returns no RX rows for Singapore.

hubs.label: Hong Kong SAR
hubs.rationale: Re-exports dominate recorded exports (mostly of mainland China origin); Comtrade returns no RX rows for Hong Kong.

hubs.label: Netherlands
hubs.rationale: Rotterdam and Schiphol: the Rotterdam effect assigns imports landed for other EU members to the Netherlands as the recorded partner.

hubs.label: Belgium
hubs.rationale: Antwerp-Bruges transshipment; a large share of recorded exports are goods in transit for other EU members.

hubs.label: Panama
hubs.rationale: Colon Free Zone re-exports; Comtrade publishes an RX flow for Panama.

hubs.label: Malaysia
hubs.rationale: Port Klang and Tanjung Pelepas transshipment hubs on the Malacca route; Comtrade returns no RX rows for Malaysia.
